result.instructions: Tools for Kolay IK, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is on leave next week?"; "How many days of annual leave does Ayse Yilmaz have left?"; "List the overtime records still waiting for approval this month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Kolay IK data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run kolayik_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run kolayik_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run kolayik_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. kolayik_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: kolayik_get_me
tools.title: Get the token's user
tools.description: The Kolay IK user the API token belongs to: id, name, email, work email. A cheap check that the connection works. GET /v2/profile/me.

tools.name: kolayik_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List employees (id, first and last name), 60 per page. By default only active employees; set status to terminated for people who left. Search by name with q. Filter by hire date (active people) or termination date (terminated people). The reply has total, currentPage and lastPage; request the next page with page. POST /v2/person/list (a read).

q.description: Search text in first and last name (or the national id number).

hired_from.description: Active people hired on or after this date.

hired_to.description: Active people hired on or before this date.

terminated_from.description: Terminated people who left on or after this date.

terminated_to.description: Terminated people who left on or before this date.

tools.name: kolayik_get_person
tools.title: Get a person
tools.description: Full profile of one employee: contact data, employment dates, contract, units, compensation and custom data fields. National id numbers and bank numbers are removed. GET /v2/person/view/{id}.

tools.name: kolayik_get_person_summary
tools.title: Get a person summary
tools.description: Short profile of one employee: name, contact data, current units (company, location, department, position) and manager. GET /v2/person/view-summary/{id}.

tools.name: kolayik_get_person_leave_balances
tools.title: Get leave balances
tools.description: Leave entitlement of one employee per leave type: earned, used, carried over and unused days. GET /v2/person/leave-status/{id}.

tools.name: kolayik_list_person_trainings
tools.title: List a person's trainings
tools.description: Trainings assigned to one employee. GET /v2/person/list-trainings/{id}.

tools.name: kolayik_list_person_fields
tools.title: List person data fields
tools.description: The custom data fields a person can have (fieldToken, type, category). Use the fieldToken in kolayik_update_person and kolayik_create_person. GET /v2/person/show-available-data-fields.

tools.name: kolayik_list_units
tools.title: List organization units
tools.description: The organization tree: unit types (company, branch, department, position ...) and their items with ids. GET /v2/unit/show-unit-tree.

tools.name: kolayik_list_approval_processes
tools.title: List approval processes
tools.description: The approval chains configured in the account (leave, expense and similar), with their steps and approvers. Filter by name or by a person in the steps. GET /v2/approval-process/list.

person_id.description: Only chains with this person in a step.

tools.name: kolayik_list_leaves
tools.title: List leave records
tools.description: List leave (time off) records, newest data first as the vendor orders them. Filter by status, a date range or one person. Each record has the leave type, dates, person, replacement, status (approved/waiting/rejected) and used days. GET /v2/leave/list.

include_inactive_employees.description: Include people who have left (default false).

tools.name: kolayik_get_leave
tools.title: Get a leave record
tools.description: One leave record with type, dates, return date, comment, person, replacement person, status and used days. GET /v2/leave/view/{id}.

tools.name: kolayik_create_leave
tools.title: Create a leave record
tools.description: WRITE: records leave for an employee and deducts the used days from their balance. The vendor may approve it immediately, and it is visible to the employee and their manager. Find the leave type id in an existing leave record (kolayik_list_leaves) or the person's balances (kolayik_get_person_leave_balances). Not idempotent: a second call creates a second record. POST /v2/leave/create.

leave_type_id.description: Leave type id (for example from kolayik_get_person_leave_balances).

tools.name: kolayik_list_timelogs
tools.title: List timelogs
tools.description: List time records (work hours, overtime) with person, start and end, minutes used, status and type. Filter by person, type, status and date range. The reply has searchCount, totalCount, page and limit. POST /v2/timelog/list (a read).

tools.name: kolayik_get_timelog
tools.title: Get a timelog
tools.description: One time record by id. GET /v2/timelog/view/{id}.

tools.name: kolayik_create_timelog
tools.title: Create a timelog
tools.description: WRITE: adds a time record (work hours or overtime) for an employee. With status approved it counts immediately (overtime may flow into payroll); with waiting it enters the approval process. Not idempotent: a second call creates a second record. POST /v2/timelog/create.

status.description: waiting (goes through the approval process), approved (counts immediately), rejected or cancelled.

tools.name: kolayik_delete_timelog
tools.title: Delete a timelog
tools.description: WRITE (destructive): permanently deletes one time record. This cannot be undone. DELETE /v2/timelog/delete/{id}.

tools.name: kolayik_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List employee transactions (expenses, advance payments, bonuses, overtime pay, deductions) with amount, currency, status, paid flag and items. Filter by person, type, status, paid and date range. POST /v2/transaction/list (a read).

paid.description: true = only paid, false = only unpaid.

tools.name: kolayik_get_transaction
tools.title: Get a transaction
tools.description: One transaction (expense, advance, bonus ...) with its items. GET /v2/transaction/view/{id}.

tools.name: kolayik_list_expense_categories
tools.title: List expense categories
tools.description: Expense categories of the account (for example taxi, meals), optionally filtered by title or enabled state. GET /v2/expense/list-categories.

enabled.description: true = only enabled categories, false = only disabled.

tools.name: kolayik_list_payrolls
tools.title: List payroll periods
tools.description: Payroll runs of a year: id, period, number of employees, payslips created, errors and total employer cost. Needs a token with the payroll:list scope. Use the id with kolayik_get_payroll_sheet. GET /v2/payroll/list.

tools.name: kolayik_get_payroll_sheet
tools.title: Get a payroll sheet
tools.description: The full payroll sheet (carsaf bordro) of one payroll run: every employee's gross, net, tax and insurance columns. This is sensitive salary data of all employees (or the filtered ones). Needs a token with the payroll-sheet:view scope. Filter by name, status, salary period, insurance, tax, expense center or units. POST /v2/payroll-sheet/view/{id} (a read).

unit_item_ids.description: Groups of unit item ids from kolayik_list_units.

items.description: A Kolay IK id (32-character hex string).

tools.name: kolayik_list_events
tools.title: List calendar events
tools.description: List company calendar events (meetings, holidays) with title, start, end and comment. Filter by text and date range. The reply has searchCount, totalCount, page and limit. GET /v2/event/list.

tools.name: kolayik_get_event
tools.title: Get a calendar event
tools.description: One calendar event. GET /v2/event/view/{id}.

tools.name: kolayik_create_event
tools.title: Create a calendar event
tools.description: WRITE: adds an event to the company calendar, visible to the employees who see it. Not idempotent. POST /v2/event/create.

tools.name: kolayik_update_event
tools.title: Update a calendar event
tools.description: WRITE: changes the title, times or comment of a calendar event (the vendor requires title, start and end). PUT /v2/event/update/{id}.

tools.name: kolayik_delete_event
tools.title: Delete a calendar event
tools.description: WRITE (destructive): permanently deletes one calendar event. This cannot be undone. DELETE /v2/event/delete/{id}.

tools.name: kolayik_list_trainings
tools.title: List trainings
tools.description: List the trainings defined in the account. Filter by title text. The reply has searchCount, totalCount, page and limit. GET /v2/training/list.

tools.name: kolayik_get_training
tools.title: Get a training
tools.description: One training with its details. GET /v2/training/view/{id}.

tools.name: kolayik_create_person
tools.title: Create a person
tools.description: WRITE: adds a new employee (only first and last name are required). Creates a real HR record that may send the person an invitation, depending on the account settings. Not idempotent: calling it twice creates a duplicate. Further data goes in data_fields (see kolayik_list_person_fields). POST /v2/person/create.

value.description: The new value; null or an empty string clears it.

tools.name: kolayik_update_person
tools.title: Update a person
tools.description: WRITE: changes basic data of one employee; only the fields you pass change. Pass null for an optional field to clear it. Further data goes in data_fields (see kolayik_list_person_fields). Changes the HR record immediately. PUT /v2/person/update.

value.description: The new value; null or an empty string clears it.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Kolay IK
prompts.description: What you can do with Kolay IK here, with example requests to try.
